name: XR Head Aim
author: Riley
description: Aim in games by turning your head with XR glasses (VITURE, XREAL, Rokid, RayNeo via XRLinuxDriver): low-lag mouse or controller right-stick aim, optional PS5 DualSense-as-Xbox-pad bridge, live tuning from the bar.

barWidget.description: Head aim on/off, output mode and live tuning
